description: This Python script provides a client implementation for Veo video generation using LiteLLM proxy. It defines a class VeoVideoGenerator with methods to generate videos, poll for their completion, and download the resulting video files. The script also includes a main() function demonstrating how to use this class with example prompts, along with configuration instructions.

classes.name: VeoVideoGenerator
classes.description: Client for interacting with Veo video generation API through LiteLLM proxy. Provides methods to initiate video creation, poll status, and download the generated video.

methods.description: Starts the video generation process with a given prompt.

methods.name: VeoVideoGenerator.wait_for_completion
methods.description: Polls the status of the video generation operation until completion or timeout.

methods.name: VeoVideoGenerator.download_video
methods.description: Downloads the generated video from the provided URI.

methods.name: VeoVideoGenerator.generate_and_download
methods.description: Executes the full workflow: generate video, wait for completion, and download.
